title: All Living Beings' Faces
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped into Xuanwu Sect, he discovered that what Mo Xiansheng was waiting for him was not just a conversation—but a truth that could overturn his entire life.

text.content: The night of the imperial capital was as dark as ink, the autumn wind carrying the chill of early autumn brushing against the crumbling city walls. Chen Ji stood alone on the ruins, his chest heaving violently, that roar having exhausted too much of his strength. Moonlight poured through the gaps in the clouds, illuminating his pallid face—the mark of the Tianji Record's backlash, the price he paid with his life for 'foresight'. All around was deathly silence, as if the entire world had held its breath at this moment, waiting for his next move.

Footsteps approached from the distance, light yet resolute. Chen Ji didn't turn around, but he recognized this gait—it was Su Qingyao. She should have been guarding the Inner Sect of Tianqing Sect tonight, yet she had somehow arrived here. As a cloak was gently draped over his shoulders, Chen Ji felt a stream of warm spiritual energy flow into his body, steadying his wavering breath. 'Fool, who told you to run out here alone?' Su Qingyao's voice was soft, carrying a hint of reproach but even more concern. Beneath the moonlight, her typically cold and elegant face now appeared as gentle as water.

dialogue.content: 'Do you know how long I've been searching for you?' Su Qingyao stood at his side, her gaze fixed on the distant horizon. 'The entire Tianqing Sect has been looking for you, and I... I knew you would be here.' Her voice trembled slightly. 'Chen Ji, how long will you keep hiding the truth from me? The curse of the Tianji Record... I've seen it. Every time you use it, you're spending something.' She turned to face him directly, her eyes reddened but refusing to let tears fall. 'Did you think I couldn't see it? Four words are written all over your pale face—your days are numbered.'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. He had always believed he was hiding it well, that everyone would be fooled by his 'waste' appearance. But Su Qingyao was different. She was the only one who had come infinitely close to the truth three times. 'Qingyao, you don't understand.' He finally spoke, his voice hoarse. 'This is not something you can meddle with.'

dialogue.content: 'Don't understand?' Su Qingyao let out a light laugh, a hint of resolve in that smile. 'Chen Ji, you underestimate me too much.' She extended her hand, and a pale golden mark appeared on her palm—the core technique of the 'Qingluan Art,' the supreme heart method of Tianqing Sect. 'This is what I can give you.' She said. 'The third level of Qingluan Art can help you share part of the... Tianji Record's curse. Not all of it, but I'm willing.' She looked into his eyes, speaking word by word. 'Whatever the cost, I will be by your side.'

text.content: The night wind suddenly turned frigid. A black figure descended from the sky, carrying a faint aura of demonic energy. Ye Qing landed before the two of them. The Holy Sect's Saintess of the Demonic Path had now concealed all her sharpness. Her gaze fell upon Su Qingyao, and she gave a slight nod—a silent acknowledgment between two women who should have been adversaries. 'It seems I've arrived at just the right moment.' Ye Qing said softly. A black jade slip materialized in her hand. 'Chen Ji, this is our Holy Sect's forbidden technique, 'Demon Source Life-Extending Method'.' She handed the jade slip toward him. 'It can delay your life consumption, but the price is... you will be tainted by demonic energy. Given your mindset, you should be able to suppress it.'

dialogue.content: 'Don't look at me like that.' Ye Qing seemed to see through his thoughts, a meaningful smile curling at her lips. 'When you used the Tianji Record to show me that prophecy, I already said—we're on the same boat.' Her voice suddenly dropped lower. 'Besides... I have things I want to protect too. Trading this for your trust is a good deal.'

text.content: Just then, a gentle voice sounded from the void. 'Brother.' Chen Nian's figure slowly materialized. She was much thinner than Chen Ji remembered, with faint dark circles under her eyes—clearly this period had been hard on her too. But her eyes burned with unusual brightness, filled with determination. 'I know what you're worried about.' Chen Nian walked up to him, extending her hand—countless silver threads finer than hair spread from her fingertips. That was her 'Threads of Fate' ability. 'My ability can buy you time.' She said. 'Any inevitable death in the prophecies, I can rewrite for you, even just for an instant. That instant... is your chance to survive.'

dialogue.content: 'Niannian...' Chen Ji looked at his sister's gaunt face, feeling as if something was tightly gripping his heart. All these years he had been scheming to find her, never knowing she had been... protecting him in her own way. Chen Nian seemed to read his gaze, smiling faintly. 'Brother, you said you would protect me. So, I want to protect you too. This is the... bond between us.'

text.content: Just as the three were wordlessly facing each other, an old yet vigorous voice suddenly rang out in the night sky. 'What a bond, what a protection.' Chen Ming stepped out from the void, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion token gleaming softly under the moonlight. This mysterious elder's face carried both relief and worry. 'Chen Ji, do you know the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion has turned upside down because of you?' He glanced around, confirming no one else was present before continuing. 'The Pavilion Master believes you are an important piece that cannot be lost. But the three elders think you are too dangerous and want to... strike first before you grow stronger.'

dialogue.content: 'And I, support you.' Chen Ming's gaze toward Chen Ji carried complex emotions. 'Not because you are the successor, but because... you showed me another possibility.' He paused. 'The existence of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion itself is a chess piece of the Heavenly Dao, but we do not necessarily have to... resist.'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. The word 'resist' carried such weight that it made his heart shiver. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion had always operated under the principle of 'following Heaven and complying with fate.' To hear someone say they wanted to resist... Just as he wanted to press for answers, a familiar spiritual fluctuation reached his divine sense—it was Mo Xiansheng's message. Illusory words appeared in his mind: 'Kid, you're finally walking your own path. But now is not the time for sentiment. Return to Xuanwu Sect quickly, there are urgent matters to discuss. The page of the Tianji Record in your body... has begun to stir.'

Stir? Chen Ji instinctively probed inward with his divine sense, indeed feeling the Tianji Record fragment emitting pulses of faint light, that glow seeming to contain some restless emotion. He remembered what Mo Xiansheng had said—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of fate. And this page in his body... seemed to be awakening some kind of power. 'Brother?' Chen Nian noticed his unusual state and asked with concern. Chen Ji shook his head. Just as he was about to speak, Su Qingyao had already grasped his hand first. 'Whatever happens, we face it together.' She said, her gaze resolute. Ye Qing and Chen Ming also nodded. Even Chen Nian gently tugged at his sleeve, silently expressing her support.

choice.prompt: Facing this sudden support and information, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Accept Su Qingyao's Qingluan Art, Ye Qing's Demon Source Life-Extending Method, and Chen Nian's Threads of Fate, formally forming an alliance.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the side effects of shared curse and demonic contamination
choices.visible_reward: Gain three benefits: Qingluan Art Protection (curse consumption -30%), Demon Source Life-Extension (delayed life consumption), Threads of Fate Protection (one chance to rewrite a fatal ending)
choices.risk_hint: Sharing the curse means Su Qingyao will also be affected
choices.process_label: 陈机接受众人的心意，组建真正的联盟

text.content: Su Qingyao did not hesitate to channel the Qingluan Art heart method into Chen Ji's body. That pale golden spiritual energy was warm and steadfast, creating a strange resonance with the cold heavenly secrets power in Chen Ji's body. At the same time, Ye Qing pressed the Demon Source Life-Extending jade slip against his brow center, and black demonic energy slowly seeped in. Chen Nian gently grasped his fingers, and those silver threads of fate wound around his wrists like some silent vow. The moment the three powers converged, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented warmth surge in his heart. His eyes grew moist, but he quickly suppressed his emotions, raising his head to sweep his gaze across everyone present. 'Thank you all.' His voice was soft, yet exceptionally firm. 'I will not disappoint you.'

dialogue.content: 'Don't say such formal things.' Su Qingyao huffed lightly, though the corners of her mouth couldn't help but curl upward. 'From now on, your enemies are my enemies. The path you walk, no matter how difficult, I will walk to the very end with you.'

choices.description: Temporarily refuse their intentions, claim you can still hold on, and not want to burden them.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance for immediate support, face the Tianji Record's agitation alone
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent judgment, but this will make allies feel alienated
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record's agitation may spiral out of control, facing it alone carries extreme risk
choices.process_label: 陈机决定独自面对，但内心开始动摇

text.content: "...I can still hold on." Chen Ji shook his head, his voice somewhat hoarse. "The Tianji Record's agitation remains controllable. You don't need to go to such lengths for me." Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly, clearly dissatisfied with his response. Ye Qing glanced at him thoughtfully, silent. Chen Nian lowered her head, a hint of disappointment flickering in her eyes. The atmosphere grew subtly strained, and Chen Ji sensed an invisible crack quietly forming. "I'm not trying to distance myself from you," he added. "It's just... there are some things I'd rather handle on my own first."

dialogue.content: "Handle it myself?" Su Qingyao's voice suddenly turned cold. "Chen Ji, do you think we're outsiders? Do you think I'd watch you die?" Her eyes reddened again, but this time she couldn't hold back, tears finally streaming down her face. At this moment, she was no longer the high-and-mighty Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, merely a woman afraid of losing the one she loved.

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at this scene, feeling an unexpected softness emerge in his heart. These people... each was an indispensable piece in his carefully laid plans, yet as they stood before him, offering their hearts without reservation, he suddenly realized—they were more than mere chess pieces. Su Qingyao was willing to share his curse, Ye Qing risked everything with the Holy Sect for his sake, and Chen Nian sacrificed her freedom for him. Chen Ming, who should have remained a detached observer of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets, chose to stand with him instead. The night wind carried a faint, distant floral fragrance. Chen Ji shut his eyes, inhaled deeply, then slowly opened them. Beneath the moonlight, his gaze shone clearer than ever before. "Alright," he finally said, his voice carrying a tenderness he had never before revealed. "I accept your kindness."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao broke into laughter through her tears, raising her hand to gently punch his shoulder: "Should have done this long ago! You made me worry for nothing." Ye Qing also showed a rare smile, blooming on her cold demonic sect features like red plum blossoms in snow. Chen Ming stroked his beard, nodding with satisfaction. Chen Nian threw herself into his arms, hugging him tightly. "Brother, welcome back." Her voice was muffled, carrying a sob. "Welcome back to our side."

text.content: Having gathered his composure, Chen Ji began contemplating his next move. Mo Xiansheng's message made him realize the Tianji Record's agitation was no trivial matter. And Xuanwu Sect, as one of the three great sects, had always been a focal point of power plays among various forces. This journey was dangerous, but he had to go. However, before departing, he needed to make some arrangements. After all, the imperial city, though ruined, remained a confluence of various powers. He needed to ensure that after his departure, the situation here wouldn't spiral out of control. "Senior Chen Ming." He turned to the elder from the Hall of Heavenly Secrets. "The imperial city still needs your care."

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji arrange for the upcoming trip to Xuanwu Sect?

choices.description: Go to Xuanwu Sect together with Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Chen Nian, and Chen Ming, showcasing the team's strength.
choices.visible_cost: Target is too large, may attract attention
choices.visible_reward: Demonstrate team cohesion and the protagonist's leadership qualities
choices.risk_hint: Xuanwu Sect's stance is unclear, large-scale action may provoke unnecessary conflicts
choices.process_label: 众人决定一同前往玄武宗

text.content: "Since we're a team, this is a team operation." Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, his voice carrying unprecedented confidence. "We go to Xuanwu Sect together. Let them see—in Chen Ji's chess game, there's never just me alone." Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Ming all nodded in agreement. Even Chen Nian clenched her fists, her eyes sparkling with anticipation. Under the moonlight, five figures stood side by side, like a frozen painting.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Ye Qing murmured softly, a meaningful smile curving her lips. "For the demonic sect's saint to travel alongside Tianqing Sect's senior fellow, that's a first. I'm curious what expression Xuanwu Sect members will have when they see this."

choices.description: Go to Xuanwu Sect alone to meet Mo Xiansheng, leaving others in the imperial city to provide support.
choices.visible_reward: Reduce the risk of target exposure, preserve backup plans
choices.risk_hint: May miss opportunities for coordinated combat with allies
choices.process_label: 陈机决定独自前往，让盟友作为后手

text.content: "No, more people would only alert our quarry." Chen Ji shook his head, his eyes gleaming with shrewd calculation. "I'll go meet Mo Xiansheng alone first. You stay on standby in the imperial city. If anything happens, we can still act without delay." Though worried, Su Qingyao knew he spoke reason and could only nod in agreement. Ye Qing handed him a communication jade talisman: "Contact us anytime if something comes up. We can support you at any moment."

dialogue.content: "Brother, be careful." Chen Nian whispered her reminder, silver threads of fate quietly coiling around his wrist. "I'll be watching over you the whole time."

Chen Ming stroked his beard and nodded. "Rest assured. I'll find ways to resolve the divisions within the Hall of Heavenly Secrets. Just focus on your business." He paused, then added, "By the way, there's something I must warn you about—Lin Yuan, that old fox, has been making frequent moves lately. When you return to Xuanwu Sect, be wary of him." Chen Ji's gaze subtly tightened. Lin Yuan, the old sect master of Tianqing Sect, the one who sheltered him on the surface but harbored hidden dangers beneath. He had long been on guard against this person, but he hadn't expected Chen Ming to specifically warn him. It seemed Lin Yuan's threat was greater than he had imagined.

text.content: The night wind grew chillier, and the darkness before dawn was about to arrive. Chen Ji stood atop the ruins, behind him the three figures of Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Nian, ahead the unknown path and challenges. His Tianji Record fragment still glowed faintly, seemingly responding to some change within his heart. "Let's go." He said softly, taking the first step forward. Light footsteps followed from behind—that was his allies catching up. Under the moonlight, Chen Ji suddenly stopped, turning to look at the three people behind him. "Thank you." He said, his voice carrying a rare warmth. "I'm no longer alone."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stepped forward and stood shoulder to shoulder with him: "That goes without saying. From now on, your path is our shared path. Whether the road ahead leads through thorns or smooth ground, we will walk it together." Ye Qing also nodded: "The Demonic Path follows the code of repaying grudges as well as kindness. You saved me once, and I will remember this debt for a lifetime." Chen Nian gently tugged at Chen Ji's robe, looking up at him: "Brother, Nian Nian will always be by your side. Forever."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at them, warmth flooding his heart. He recalled Mo Xiansheng's words — "This child, finally beginning to walk his own path." Indeed, he was no longer a chess piece walking on thin ice under the Tianji Record's control, nor a solitary schemer weaving grand designs. From this moment, he embarked on his own path — one walked side by side with allies. A morning sun rose in the east, golden light dispelling the darkness of night. Chen Ji took a deep breath, his eyes burning with unprecedented fighting spirit. "Since they wish to play chess, let them witness my chess game." His voice echoed in the morning wind, brimming with pride that looked down upon the world. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Nian exchanged knowing glances and followed in his footsteps. Far away in Xuanwu Sect, Mo Xiansheng opened his eyes, gazing toward the imperial capital. An aged smile of satisfaction crossed his weathered face. "Go forth, children," he murmured. "Forge the future that belongs to you. The chess game of Heavenly Secrets... should finally change."
